links.outcome: Head-to-head accuracy of seven TB-CAD products and radiologist on same data
links.effect: qXR performed as good as the radiologist; CAD4TB, Insight CXR, DrAid, Genki AUCROC adults ≥0.80, children ≥0.90; InferRead DR Chest and Radify Chest performed less well
links.quote: CAD4TB, Insight CXR, DrAid, and Genki also demonstrated high accuracy (AUCROC: adults ≥0.80, AUCROCs children ≥0.90), while InferRead DR Chest and Radify Chest performed less well.

links.outcome: Local accuracy of CAD products against microbiological reference standard in Indian PHIs
links.effect: qXR AUCROC 0.88 (95% CI 0.85-0.90) adults and 0.95 (0.89-1.0) children; several products high accuracy, two performed less well locally
links.quote: Local validation confirmed high accuracy for qXR and several other products, in identifying TB in adults and children in India, supporting their potential implementation in similar settings.
